exact_section.evidence_summary: Covers non-complex fracture assessment and follow-up, repeated pain assessment, definitive X-ray reporting, Ottawa ankle and foot rules, and selected scaphoid imaging.

exact_source_references.source_organisation: National Institute for Health and Care Excellence
exact_source_references.source_document_title: Fractures (non-complex): assessment and management — Recommendations

exact_section.heading: Recommendations 1.4.1–1.4.10 — ongoing orthopaedic management
exact_section.evidence_summary: Supports selected orthopaedic follow-up, stability review, weight-bearing, cast or fixation context, and return review for non-improving symptoms in specified fracture populations.

exact_source_references.source_organisation: National Institute for Health and Care Excellence
exact_source_references.source_document_title: Fractures (non-complex): assessment and management — Recommendations

exact_section.heading: Recommendations 1.5.1–1.6.12 — documentation, information, and support
exact_section.evidence_summary: Requires structured fracture documentation, image and report continuity, honest information, questions, treatment expectations, rehabilitation, mobilisation, weight-bearing, management-plan communication, and documentation.

exact_section.evidence_summary: Supports deformity, distal pulse, capillary refill, sensation, neurovascular compromise, open fracture, splinting, and perfusion reassessment documentation.

exact_source_references.source_document_title: Basic emergency care: approach to the acutely ill and injured
